marathon_definition.explanation: A creator is marked as a marathon streamer when a reconstructed session lasts at least 24 hours or their total event streaming time is at least 75% of all possible event hours. Broadcasts restarted within 90 minutes are treated as one logical session.

metric_definitions.average_viewers: Arithmetic mean of the average-viewer value across broadcasts.
metric_definitions.effort_ratio: During-SU hours streamed per calendar day divided by pre-SU hours streamed per calendar day.
metric_definitions.viewer_growth_pct: Percentage change from pre-SU average viewers to During-SU average viewers.
metric_definitions.expected_followers_during_su: Pre-SU followers gained per calendar day multiplied by the number of event days.
metric_definitions.follower_uplift_absolute: During-SU followers gained minus the amount expected from the pre-SU daily rate.
metric_definitions.size_tier: Size tier based on pre-SU average viewers.

methodology_notes: Comparisons describe performance during the event relative to a 30-day baseline and do not prove causation.
Creators with no pre-SU streams remain visible, but comparison metrics are null rather than zero.
Group summaries use medians for creator-level comparison because Twitch data is highly skewed.
Control creators were not part of Streamer University.
